Leadership

C.F. Møller Architects is one of Scandinavia’s leading architectural firms and has been synonymous with award-winning architecture in the Nordic countries and around the world for over 100 years. Møller Architects, where a passion for design, holistic thinking, and the commitment to turning creative ideas into compelling solutions shape our daily work.

We are looking for a Support Program Manager to join our Support Delivery team. This role is an exciting opportunity to help define and implement foundational support practices that will scale with OpenAI’s growth.

You will lead efforts to establish new operational frameworks, driving process alignment with various internal teams, and leading tooling and automation projects. This position offers the chance to make a significant impact in shaping customer experience while collaborating across multiple teams.
We’re looking for people who thrive at the intersection of project management, systems building, data science/data engineering/software engineering, team enablement, and customer advocacy – and enjoy working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
This role is based in San Francisco, CA, and follows a hybrid work model of 3 days in-office per week. Relocation assistance is available.

Lead support delivery programs for Tier 3 frontline delivery for our most strategic customers, including productivity and workflow improvements, team operations, and knowledge management for the Support Delivery team

Lead strategy and program design for internal support initiatives, including specialization programs, quality initiatives, community support, product reliability and launch supportability
Coordinate requirements, implementation, and ongoing iteration with internal build owners and systems partners
Lead projects to identify, implement, and scale tools and automation that improve customer support efficiency and effectiveness
Identify and scale practical AI-powered workflows across support operations, using automation, LLMs, and internal tooling to reduce manual work, improve resolution quality, and help the team operate more effectively at scale
Collaborate across teams to identify opportunities for improvement, reduce friction, and enhance overall customer satisfaction
Help shape the vision and strategy of a new team, contributing to its long-term success and influence across the organization

At KPFF Consulting Engineers, we are more than just an engineering design firm. For 65 years, we have dedicated ourselves to innovative, sustainable engineering that shapes the built environment and tackles complex infrastructure challenges. With nearly 1,500 professionals across 36 offices nationwide, KPFF’s decentralized structure allows each office the flexibility to pursue projects aligned with their regional strengths. Learn more at www.kpff.com.

Job Description

We’re hiring a Structural Project Manager to support and grow our Austin, Texas team. This senior-level role is ideal for a licensed structural engineer ready to lead complex building design projects, deepen client relationships, and contribute to the continued expansion of KPFF’s presence across Central Texas and surrounding markets.

At KPFF, you’ll manage vertical structure projects from concept through construction administration, mentor a talented group of engineers, and actively support business development initiatives. You’ll collaborate closely with architects, developers, owners, and contractors to deliver high-quality structural designs for commercial, residential, mixed-use, education, healthcare, and institutional projects.

As you grow with us, you’ll also have opportunities to pursue pathways to ownership, reflecting KPFF’s commitment to recognizing leadership, technical excellence, and long-term contributions.

This is a hybrid role, with an expectation of being in the Austin office three days per week for collaboration, mentoring, and client meetings. While we support flexible work arrangements, this role is not fully remote. In-person presence is especially important for leadership engagement, technical mentorship, and client interaction.

What You’ll Be Doing

Serve as the primary technical and client-facing lead on structural projects, ensuring strong relationships and successful delivery.
Lead project execution from schematic design through construction administration, managing schedules, budgets, quality standards, and team performance.
Oversee and review structural analysis and design for steel, concrete, wood, and masonry building systems.
Direct preparation of construction documents including calculations, drawings, specifications, and design narratives.
Coordinate closely with architects, MEP consultants, contractors, fabricators, and specialty structural reviewers.
Collaborate with teams in both Austin and San Diego, supporting projects across markets as part of our integrated reporting center structure.
Navigate Texas jurisdictional approval processes and building code compliance, including:
International Building Code (IBC) and local amendments
City of Austin Development Services Department
Special inspections and threshold building coordination
Provide construction-phase support including shop drawing review, RFIs, site observations, and field coordination.
Support business development efforts including proposals, interviews, and cultivating relationships with local clients and design partners.
Mentor and develop engineers and designers, fostering both technical excellence and leadership growth.
Represent KPFF in industry organizations and local professional groups, contributing to the visibility and reputation of the Austin team.

Bachelor’s degree in Structural Engineering or Civil Engineering with structural emphasis (Master’s preferred).
PE license required.
8+ years of structural engineering experience, primarily focused on building design.
Proven experience managing multi-discipline building projects and coordinating consultant teams.
Strong working knowledge of steel, concrete, wood, and masonry design.
Experience applying national codes and standards including IBC, ASCE 7, AISC, ACI, NDS, and TMS specifications.
Proficiency with structural analysis and design tools such as ETABS, RAM, RISA, SAFE, and project coordination platforms, with working familiarity drafting tools used by production teams.
Demonstrated leadership capabilities with experience mentoring staff engineers.
Effective communicator with strong organizational and client-facing skills.
Ability to work in the Austin office at least three days per week under the hybrid work model.
Additional Information

Physical Demands

Work is primarily performed in a standard office setting with long periods of work at a computer.
Occasional lifting of items up to 15 pounds.
Visits to construction sites may involve walking, standing, climbing stairs or ladders, navigating uneven surfaces, or exposure to weather.
Local travel may be required for project meetings, observations, or client visits.

The expected salary range for this position is $100,000 - $140,000 with candidates who have at least 8 years of experience, proven project management skills, and business development success. Final compensation will also consider education, licensure, and overall skills. We also provide performance-based bonuses to recognize outstanding contributions.

For those who demonstrate long-term impact and leadership, KPFF offers pathways to ownership, creating opportunities to directly share in the firm’s growth and success. During the interview process, we’ll review the full compensation package and answer any questions you may have.

You want to run projects. Not just work on them - actually own them, lead the team, build the client relationship, and put your name on the outcome.

If you've spent the last few years building your craft and you're ready to step into a project leadership role across commercial, multi-family, education, civic, or mixed-use work - let's talk.

Who We Are

Holmes US is an international structural engineering firm with offices up and down the West Coast and a home base that goes back over 65 years to New Zealand. We're part of the Holmes Group - 500+ people worldwide - which means you get the resources and technical depth of a global firm alongside the culture and relationships of a West Coast practice where people actually know each other.

Our Structures Practice takes on the kind of work that shapes how people experience their city: university buildings, multi-family housing, civic projects, commercial developments, and seismic retrofits of the buildings already standing. The variety is intentional - it keeps the work interesting and the skill set broad.

What You'll Actually Do

Lead structural engineering projects from concept through construction administration across commercial, multi-family, education, civic, or mixed-use building types
Own client relationships - managing scope, schedule, budget, and expectations with clarity and consistency
Develop technically rigorous structural solutions across concrete, steel, wood, and masonry
Direct, mentor, and develop a team of engineers and designers
Drive quality control and technical reviews on your projects
Contribute to business development through strong client relationships and repeat work
Collaborate across Holmes practice areas - and, when a project calls for it, across our international offices
4-8+ years of structural engineering experience in a consultancy setting

s.h: PE license required; SE license preferred or in active pursuit

B.S. or M.S. in Civil / Structural Engineering
Seismic design experience - this is core to our practice, not a bonus
Demonstrated ability to manage projects and lead or mentor a team
Strong communication skills - you're as comfortable presenting to a client as you are reviewing calcs

At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'

Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.

We believe electricity powers modern life. As part of our Power sector, you’ll help shape how electricity is generated, transmitted and delivered as global energy demands grow.

From massive data centers to modernizing transmission systems, our industry-recognized engineers and scientists have been at the forefront of grid transformation for more than a century. You’ll work side-by-side with these experts and contribute to reliable, resilient and sustainable power systems, helping communities thrive and industries expand.

This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to drive infrastructure forward, power innovation and leave your mark on our energy future.

As a Power Generation Project Manager, you will be joining a highly capable, multi-discipline team that supports power and energy projects in the industrial, institutional, IPP, data center and utility power industry.

You will be supporting projects involving traditional generation technologies (gas fired engines /turbines / boilers, combined heat and power systems) as well as renewables (solar /wind) and battery energy storage (Li-Ion /long duration).

You are a seller-doer who helps maintain client relationships (from pre-positioning for the work through project completion), brings in projects, develops strategies for performing the work, and leads multi-discipline project teams to successful completion of the work.

Lead the project team, manage schedule + budget, coordinate with engineering disciplines, monitoring and communication of project status, and provide engineering support for detailed design, and Owner’s Engineer projects on both a technical and contractual level.
Provide daily leadership to the project team and technical staff in completion of project activities.
Develop the project work plan for the execution of the project.
Achieve project schedule, quality, and profitability goals. Identify and process scope changes.
Maintain regular communication and coordination within the project team and with the client such that the project work plan and the client’s expectations on deliverables are understood and aligned. Monitor project deliverables for quality, completeness and conformance to the client’s expectations.
Develop and maintain client relations.
Perform marketing, business development, and consulting activities with existing and new clients.
Act as proposal manager and assist in the proposal preparation, review of contract terms and conditions, and evaluate risks associated with the services being offered. Develop the scope of work for the project.
Implement quality control checks per established procedures (e.g., organize and lead routine design reviews and internal quality assurance reviews).
Conduct negotiations to obtain the client’s approval and perform the contract administration of the change order.
Provide training and mentoring to project team staff on project management and project consulting issues.
Routinely report project progress to the Business Group Manager and Operations leaders.

10 years of relevant utility scale power project management experience
Demonstrated business development and strategic planning skills.
Good communication, leadership, planning and mentoring skills.
Excellent organizational, project management and communication (both written and verbal) skills.
MS Office, Adobe and other relevant software experience
TX PE or ability to obtain reciprocity

Bachelor's degree in Engineering
7 years related experience inclusive of a minimum 2 years experience in project management
Requires professional engineering license recognized by the licensing board for the location of the position offered. Example: Professional Engineer (PE or P.Eng) license.
MS Office and MS Project experience is required
Demonstrated leadership skills
An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee-owned culture is a must

Are you a passionate problem solver? Do you act with integrity and hold yourself and others to the highest standard? If the answer is, “Yes!” then we have an opportunity that will impress you. Who are we? We are ARCO, a Family of Construction Companies.

Second Order Controls – a division of ARCO/Murray National Construction – is seeking a highly motivated Cx Project Manager to join our Commissioning team based in Chicago, IL. At ARCO, every associate is empowered to drive their success.

Project Managers at ARCO have complete responsibility for project performance, customer satisfaction, and taking projects from design to completion. Each Project Manager has full profit and performance responsibility for his or her projects and unlimited growth potential.

Perform commissioning on mechanical, electrical, controls, and process systems.
Act as the commissioning lead for ARCO’s largest, most complex projects. In this role, you will be responsible for all pre-commissioning, functional testing, and troubleshooting activities, with the resource backing of all ARCO assets and trade partners.
Work directly with ARCO customers and end-users regarding commissioning status, engagement of client operations staff, and facility turnover.
Troubleshooting is a major element in this role. Candidate will not only be responsible for identifying issues, but also guiding issues from discovery, through troubleshooting/root cause analysis, to final issue resolution. Project types include Mission Critical, Advanced Manufacturing, Power & Gas Infrastructure, Municipal and Private Water Treatment, Waste-to-Value, Commercial, Controlled Environments Agriculture, and more.
Operate as the bridge between design and construction teams. Coordinate system design with installation between clients, subcontractors, and equipment vendors in a way that ensures the seamless turnover of ARCO’s projects.
Create and execute pre-commissioning equipment checklists to maintain state-of-the-art quality system installations.
Create and execute commissioning test scripts that verify correct operation of the installed systems.
Lead project commissioning meetings that accurately set expectations and coordinate schedules for all trades.
Effectively convey information to onsite superintendents and subcontractors using employee’s knowledge of the project’s systems.

Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (with a focus in Mechanical, Electrical, or Architectural preferred)
5+ years of experience in Mission Critical, Power Infrastructure, or Water Treatment preferred
Excellent problem-solving skills, with an adaptable and flexible style in working with different types of individuals
Strong understanding of engineering principles (HVAC, thermodynamics, heat transfer, process engineering)
Excellent communication and leadership skills
Highly entrepreneurial and self-motivated, with the ability to successfully work on own
Comfortable with spending time on construction jobsite – approximately 50%.
Familiar with construction practices and principles
Certification in building commissioning (QCxP, CCP, CxA or similar) is preferred but not required

Senior Project Manager (Healthcare Architecture)
· (195659)

At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we foster a culture of inclusion throughout our company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world?

Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'

Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.

We believe architecture is more than designing buildings, it’s about providing solutions to societal challenges and creating stronger, more vibrant communities. As part of our Architecture practice at HDR, you’ll contribute to the design and delivery of spaces and experiences that advance community well-being around the world.

From healing environments and learning spaces to research labs and civic landmarks and infrastructure, your work will directly influence how individuals experience the world around them. We bring together architects, planners, designers, and technical experts to solve complex design challenges with creativity, curiosity, and collaboration.

From championing design excellence with an emphasis on resilience and sustainability to pioneering innovative building technologies, your contributions will leave a lasting impact on the built environment. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to drive meaningful change and help define the future of our communities.

s.h: In the role of Senior Project Manager, we'll count on you to
s.t:
Lead complex healthcare projects from planning through design, construction, and closeout

Independently coordinate work of Project Architects and balance multidiscipline teams throughout the entire project's development

Be involved with marketing, contractual, design and production meetings

Facilitate design work sessions during all phases of delivery with the client and their representatives; and facilitate sessions in collaboration with the Project Architect and other disciplines as required to advance the work throughout all phases of delivery

Experience with California healthcare projects, including OSHPD-1 and OSHPD-3, navigating reviews, approvals, code compliance, and coordination with AHJ

Lead user group meetings and stakeholder engagement sessions with clinicians, administrators, and facilities teams to guide decision making

Coordinate staffing workload through entire project development to complete documents on schedule

Coordinate with contractors and trade partners to develop and manage pull planning schedules using Last Planner System principles, improving workflow reliability, team alignment, and schedule performance

Track financial aspects of projects, including forecasting and coordinate and adjust work effort with team to ensure that work is completed within parameters of agreed-to schedule and internal labor budget

Work with the Health Principal, Regional Controller and Managing Principal for project reviews with corporate management as needed

Champion quality control and assurance process by working with Quality Management Coordinator to facilitate quality meetings throughout all phases of project development

Participate in marketing activities representing project management requirements of proposals, schedules, fees, interview teams, etc.

Strengthen client relations through excellence in project delivery

Experience and/or interest in sustainable design/LEED PMP certification

Experience with California healthcare projects, including OSHPD-1 and OSHPD-3

Bachelor's degree in Architecture
10 years related experience
A minimum 5 years project management experience
Registered Architect
Must be able to lead a team on projects
Experience with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Project)
Knowledge and experience within the local and regional market
Good planning and mentoring skills
An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee-owned culture is a must

What We Believe
HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.

Our Commitment
As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day.

Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. Each group has an executive sponsor and is open to all employees.

We provide a comprehensive benefits package that promotes employee ownership, employee health, performance, and success, which includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, life insurance, an employee assistance program, paid time away, parental leave, paid holidays, a retirement savings plan with employer match, employee referral bonus and tuition reimbursement.

Stated benefits are for full-time regular positions. The expected compensation range for this position is San Francisco $156,156.00 - $223,080.00 and Folsom, CA $132,132 - $188,750 annually depending upon skills, experience, education and geographical location.

CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 40,000 students from 1,000+ universities, and our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. We've spent nearly a decade training the next generation of technical talent, and we just launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic, building one of the most ambitious AI workforce programs in the world.
We're now expanding into new markets and scaling our team so we can move at the speed AI is transforming the workforce. People joining CodePath now will have the opportunity to help architect the next frontier of our work.
We believe technical skill is the fastest way to turn raw talent into real opportunity. We train the engineers the AI era runs on, building toward millions of learners, hundreds of millions in revenue, and billions in economic impact. If you want to own something and be part of a 0-to-1 journey at an organization moving at the speed of AI, this is the place to build it.

Location: Remote (United States, Europe, Canada, or LATAM)
Role Type: Full-Time
Reporting to: VP of Engineering
Compensation: $140,000 to $178,000 per year for US-based applicants. Adjusted contingent on location for applicants based in Canada, LATAM, and Europe.
CodePath's educational programs run on our learning platform, a set of applications spanning admissions, course delivery, grading, career coaching, and reporting. A small engineering team builds and maintains all of it. As we build more and serve more learners, we need someone whose job is to keep that work organized, tested, and moving.
We're looking for an Engineering Project Manager who works alongside our engineers day to day. You'll keep projects organized and moving, make sure what we build gets tested and bugs get fixed, and keep the engineers, the product team, and the internal teams who use our tools in sync.
Key Activities
Keep engineering projects organized and moving: track what's in flight, flag what's blocked, and help the team stay clear on what's next
Own quality: test what we build, use AI to automate the repetitive parts, and write Capybara tests where they're worth it
Run the bug pipeline: reproduce issues, prioritize them, route them to the right engineer, and confirm the fix
Be the day-to-day connection between the engineers, the product team, and the internal teams who use our tools
Work with us to determine when adding process or rituals might be useful, but being thoughtful about the cost and friction
Report on status so the team and leadership know where things stand

4+ years in a project management, delivery, or QA role, ideally on a small engineering team
Technical enough to work closely with engineers: you can reproduce a bug, read a stack trace, and write a test case to automate fixing it
Hands-on QA experience: you've owned testing and a bug pipeline, manual or automated
Comfort using AI tools to automate work you used to do by hand
Good judgment about process: you add structure when it helps and leave it out when it doesn't
Strong written and verbal communication, and you work well with people
Comfort with ambiguity and small-team dynamics. You've worked without heavy process and know how to keep things moving without it

Familiarity with Ruby on Rails or Django codebases, the stacks we run
Experience with Capybara, RSpec, or comparable testing tools
Experience working with product managers and non-technical stakeholders
Experience as the first project manager or QA hire on a team

Responsible and accountable for representing the FAA in coordinating system safety programs such as safety assurance, safety promotion, and risk management activities within the aviation environment.

Interfaces include certificated airmen, air carriers, air agencies, air operators, general aviation organizations, designees, the general public and airport organizations. Company Description
We are Olsson. We engineer and design solutions that improve the world around us. As a company, we promise to always be responsive, transparent, and focused on results – for our people, our clients, and our company.
We’re a people-centric firm, so it’s no surprise our greatest asset is our people. The impact this creates is an environment that encourages our people to grow and be creative with their talents. This approach builds a culture that is uniquely Olsson. It allows us to grow our people as we grow our business. This, in turn, creates a lasting impact on the world around us.
Job Description
At Olsson, we are passionate about improving communities through expert engineering and design. Our people are our greatest asset, and we are committed to creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and make an impact.
Our Data Center team delivers multidisciplinary engineering and design services for some of the world's most innovative companies. These projects represent some of the largest and most complex infrastructure developments in the country, creating opportunities to solve challenging problems, collaborate across disciplines, and shape the facilities that support global connectivity.
We are seeking a Construction Administration Project Manager to help guide large-scale data center projects through the construction phase. In this role, you will connect design intent with field execution, coordinate across multidisciplinary teams, and help keep construction-phase decisions, documentation, and deliverables moving forward.

You will build trusted relationships with clients and project partners while supporting quality, safety, schedule, and successful project closeout. This role supports construction administration across data center projects and includes travel to project sites as needed for observations, meetings, and project coordination.

Serve as a primary connection between Olsson's design team, client representatives, contractors, consultants, and other project stakeholders during construction.
Coordinate construction-phase documentation, including requests for information, shop drawings, submittals, substitution requests, design packages, and related project records.
Review documentation for cross-discipline coordination, completeness, quality, and alignment with the design intent and contract documents.
Evaluate design changes and field conditions, coordinate technical input from the appropriate disciplines , and help assess potential effects on scope, schedule, and budget.
Lead or participate in project meetings, communicate decisions and action items, and follow through with the design team and project partners.
Track project progress, outstanding items, risks, and upcoming milestones while maintaining accurate and organized records.
Support project financial management through invoice coordination, change management, and monitoring of project budgets and schedules.
Conduct site observations as needed to monitor progress, identify potential deficiencies, and communicate findings to the appropriate parties .
Coordinate the resolution of technical and site-specific issues to help minimize rework, delays, and disruptions.
Support project closeout, including punch-list activities, final testing and commissioning coordination, record documents, and final deliverables.

Working collaboratively with others.
Having ownership in the work you do.
Using your talents to positively affect communities.

Bachelor's degree in Architecture , Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field. In lieu of a bachelor's degree, an associate degree with equivalent experience is required .
4+ years of experience within the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) industry with increasing project responsibilities.
2+ years of project management, construction management, or construction administration experience, which may be concurrent with overall project experience.
Understanding of engineering and design terminology, construction processes, contracts, project financials, and relevant codes.
Strong communication , organization, time management, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to build effective relationships, navigate challenging conversations, and resolve issues across project teams.
Experience with Microsoft Office and construction management platforms. Experience with Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, Newforma, Smartsheet, or similar tools is beneficial.
Commitment to exceptional client service, quality, and safety.

The typical annual salary range for this role is as listed below. Compensation may vary based on geographic location, experience, and qualifications. Employees in this role may be eligible for our performance‑based bonus and merit increases.

Additional Information
Olsson specializes in engineering and design, client advisory services, planning, field services, and environmental. Improving the world has been our mindset from the very beginning, back when Olsson first opened for business in 1956. And it will be our mindset for years to come.

**​**
Als erfahrener Software Project Manager übernimmst du die Verantwortung für externe Kundenprojekte im Softwareumfeld – von der Initialisierung über die Planung und Umsetzung bis hin zur erfolgreichen Einführung. Du schaffst Klarheit über Ziele, Scope, Budget, Termine, Prioritäten, Risiken und nächste Schritte und sorgst dafür, dass komplexe Vorhaben strukturiert, verbindlich und lösungsorientiert vorankommen.
Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für Kunden und interne Stakeholder während der Projektphase. Die Umsetzung stimmst du eng mit den Product Ownern ab, die als zentrale Schnittstelle zu den Entwicklungsteams agieren. Dabei behältst du jederzeit den Überblick über Kosten, Termine und Leistungsumfang, erkennst Abweichungen frühzeitig und klärst diese transparent und lösungsorientiert mit dem Kunden.
**Bei uns wirst du:**
· anspruchsvolle Softwareprojekte mit Kunden eigenverantwortlich planen, steuern und erfolgreich zur Einführung bringen
· als zentrale Ansprechperson für Kunden, Stakeholder, Product Owner und interne Fachbereiche agieren
· Projektziele, Scope, Budget, Termine, Prioritäten, Risiken und Abhängigkeiten aktiv managen
· Change Requests, Weiterentwicklungen und neue Anforderungen strukturiert aufnehmen, bewerten und in die Projekt- und Budgetplanung integrieren
· für klare Entscheidungen, verbindliche nächste Schritte und eine saubere Übergabe in den laufenden Service sorgen
**Du kennst dich unter anderem aus mit:**
· Projektleitung im Softwareumfeld
· Stakeholder-, Priorisierungs- und Risikomanagement
· Scope-, Budget-, Termin- und Erwartungsmanagement
· Requirements Engineering, Lösungsdesign und Change Management auf Steuerungs- und Koordinationsebene
· technischen Grundlagen der Softwareentwicklung sowie der Zusammenarbeit mit Product Ownern und Fachbereichen
**Das bringst du mit:**
· fundierte Erfahrung in der Leitung von Softwareprojekten mit externen Kunden
· die Fähigkeit, komplexe Projektkontexte souverän zu strukturieren und mehrere Themen parallel zu führen
· ein hohes Mass an Verbindlichkeit, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Durchsetzungsfähigkeit
· ein gutes Gespür für Prioritäten, Risiken, Qualität, Kundenbedürfnisse und realistische Planung
· sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Französisch- und/oder Italienischkenntnisse sind ein Plus

Täglich fahren Millionen Autos durch Deutschland, und in den meisten bleibt Platz ungenutzt. Wir ändern das.
MUVN ist ein digitaler Transportmarktplatz. Wir bringen Fahrer:innen mit freiem Laderaum mit Menschen und Unternehmen zusammen, die etwas transportieren müssen. Günstiger, versichert, ohne Umweg.
Wir bauen gerade an mehreren Dingen gleichzeitig: einem neuen Produkt für gewerbliche Versender, Piloten mit großen Marken, neuen Strecken, Integrationen. An jedem dieser Themen arbeiten mehrere Menschen aus mehreren Bereichen, und keiner von ihnen hat den vollen Überblick über alle anderen.
Genau dafür gibt es diese Stelle. Du weißt zu jeder Zeit, wo jedes Projekt steht, was als Nächstes ansteht und wo es gerade klemmt. Eine Frage zum aktuellen Sprint, und du kannst sie beantworten. Eine Frage zu einem Partnerprojekt, und du gehst auf die Leute zu und sorgst dafür, dass am Tag X alles steht.
Du bist kein Product Owner und musst nicht entwickeln können. Du musst verstehen, worum es geht, grob einschätzen können, was etwas bedeutet, und Dinge über die Ziellinie bringen.
Hierfür suchen wir dich ab dem 01.10.2026 als Verstärkung für unser Team in Hamburg 🚀
Aufgaben
Überblick über alle Projekte
Du führst die Timeline über Marktplatz, unser Produkt für gewerbliche Versender, Integrationen und Partnerprojekte. Status, nächster Meilenstein, offene Entscheidungen, Risiken. Alles an einem Ort, aktuell, und für jeden im Team in zwei Minuten auffindbar.
Themen aktiv vorantreiben
Du wartest nicht auf Statusmeldungen, du holst sie dir. Freundlich und hartnäckig, bis erledigt wirklich erledigt heißt.
Abhängigkeiten und Termine
Du erkennst früh, wo sich Themen gegenseitig blockieren, über Tech, Marketing, Operations und externe Partner hinweg. Und du eskalierst konkret: nicht "das wird knapp", sondern "wenn X bis Freitag nicht steht, verschiebt sich Y um zwei Wochen".
Launches und Piloten
Du planst und begleitest den Start neuer Produkte, Features und Partnerprojekte. Wer liefert was bis wann, was muss am Tag X stehen, was lernen wir danach. Und du baust Checklisten, die beim zweiten Mal besser funktionieren als beim ersten.
Schnittstelle zu Tech
Wir sind ein technisches Produkt, deshalb hängt vieles an unserem CTO. Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen ihm und den laufenden Projekten. Du verstehst genug vom Thema, um in einem Kunden- oder Partnergespräch grob einzuschätzen, was etwas bedeutet, und um die richtige Rückfrage zu stellen.
Ziele und Rhythmus
Du hältst den Takt: Zyklen, Check-ins, Reviews, sichtbarer Fortschritt. Die Ziele setzen die Gründer:innen und die Verantwortlichen. Dass sie nachgehalten werden, liegt bei dir.
Meetings und Entscheidungen
Für deine projektübergreifenden Runden bereitest du vor und nach: Agenda, Unterlagen, Ergebnisse, To-dos mit Verantwortlichem und Datum. Entscheidungen dokumentierst du so, dass sie zwei Wochen später nicht neu verhandelt werden.
Externe Partner
Agenturen, Pilotpartner, Dienstleister. Du steuerst die Zusammenarbeit: Lieferungen, Termine, Feedbackschleifen.
Prozesse und KI
Wiederkehrendes standardisierst du mit Vorlagen und Checklisten. Du arbeitest KI-first: Statusberichte, Protokolle, Recherche und Dokumentation baust du mit KI. Was dabei rauskommt, prüfst du. Die Richtigkeit gehört dir, nicht dem Tool.
Qualifikation
Du hast mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im Projekt- oder Programmmanagement, gerne in einem Startup, einer Agentur oder einem digitalen Produktumfeld. Du hast schon einmal ein Projekt mit mehreren Beteiligten und einem harten Termin über die Ziellinie gebracht, ohne selbst die fachliche Arbeit gemacht zu haben.
Du bist nah dran an digitalen Produkten. Tiefe Technikkenntnisse brauchst du nicht, aber du musst Sachzusammenhänge verstehen und grob einschätzen können, was ein Wunsch bedeutet, bevor du ihn zusagst.

The Arctic is a place of extremes: unforgiving, untamed, and undergoing rapid change. A literal defrosting reveals a multi-trillion-dollar opportunity spanning energy, defence, logistics, research, and infrastructure.
ARD was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox - an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence - is why we exist. Our solution is autonomy.
We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to.
Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk.

Our engineering team is expanding rapidly, and we’re looking for a Technical Project Manager to sit at the heart of it, driving delivery across our engineering portfolio. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on ambiguity, moves fast, and can bring order to multiple complex, multi-disciplinary hardware projects without slowing them down.
You'll be responsible for planning, tracking, and de-risking delivery across products at varying stages of maturity - from early-TRL prototypes through to fielded, mission-ready systems - and from field-ready energy systems to autonomous surface and sub-surface platforms.

Own project planning and delivery tracking across concurrent engineering projects and work streams (firmware, electronics, mechanical, testing), translating product strategy and portfolio priorities into executable projects with clear milestones, owners, and outcomes.
Convert ambitious commercial and operational deadlines into realistic, resourced delivery plans — holding the line on both ambition and delivery discipline.
Maintain visibility across work streams, dependencies, risks, decisions, and resourcing gaps, managing technical risk and dependency mapping across products at different Technology Readiness Levels (TRL) and adjusting project rigour and testing requirements accordingly.
Take ownership of BOMs for any existing and future products, manage key supplier relationships and keep track of all materials deliveries.
Technical Expertise: Understand the architecture, dependencies, and technical challenges of hardware design and development. Support engineering teams in resolving technical issues. Ensure compliance with industry standards and government regulations, such as MIL-STD, UK DEFSTAN, and STANAG testing and qualification requirements across the product lifecycle.
Act as the connective tissue across engineering, procurement, business development, security, product, commercial, and customers — driving cross-functional alignment and ensuring technical progress, customer commitments, and delivery constraints are understood on all sides.
Identify and resolve blockers fast, escalate early and clearly, and provide concise, decision-ready updates on consequential tradeoffs.
Build and refine the project management tooling, processes, and reporting cadence as ARD scales — you'll be creating much of this from scratch.
Identify missing handoffs and unwritten work, converting them into accountable plans, and facilitate requirements and scope definition with product, customer, and technical owners.
Lead pilots, implementations, migrations, rollouts, adoption, and operational handoffs.

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Computer, Aerospace, Mechanical Engineering, or adjacent discipline - or - experience working in a technical engineering role prior to working as a project manager.
4+ years proven experience in Technical Engineering Project Management across multiple concurrent projects,, delivering complex hardware products, ideally in defence, aerospace, or another regulated hardware environment; and ideally at a range of company maturity stages.
Working familiarity with MIL-STD testing standards, UK DEFSTAN, and NATO STANAG requirements, and how these shape project planning and qualification timelines.
Comfort operating across a range of TRL levels — from early, rapid prototyping and experimentation through to production-grade delivery — and judgement on how to flex process accordingly.
A genuine start-up mentality: comfortable with ambiguity, resourcefulness, and getting hands dirty where needed, rather than waiting for the perfect process.
A track record of hitting ambitious deadlines in fast-moving, resource-constrained environments.
Strong stakeholder management skills — able to communicate technical risk and progress clearly to both engineers and non-technical leadership.
Willingness to travel to remote and extreme environments as part of the role if deemed necessary.

Knowledge of environmental and reliability testing (e.g. thermal cycling, vibration, shock)
Familiarity of electrical systems to ensure a holistic approach to hardware design
Basic understanding of RF systems and components
Previous experience working within an R&D workshop
Experience with satellite communications, RF hardware, or Arctic/extreme-environment systems.
Familiarity with export control considerations (ITAR/EAR, UK export licensing) relevant to dual-use technology.
Experience working with or alongside defence primes, MOD, or NATO procurement processes.

Equity: meaningful options as an early employee at an early-stage company
Private Healthcare for you and your family, including dental and optical
Enhanced maternity & paternity leave
Mission-driven culture: focus on impact, not hours logged
Small team, real ownership: what you build matters and ships

About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Every contact that reaches a customer support agent, and every credit issued to customers, represents a defect somewhere in our system. This role exists to help find those defects, trace them to their source, and work with the teams responsible to eliminate them at a systemic level.
This is a high impact senior program management role within the EMEA Customer Experience organisation, reporting to the Director of Defect Elimination and Customer Experience. The Senior Program Manager is accountable for turning customer experience signals from Wolt and/or Deliveroo markets into clear, actionable insight, and for driving the resulting fixes through to resolution with partner teams.
What you’ll be doing
You will own the delivery of the defect elimination program across EMEA, including application of the defect driver taxonomy to identify where defect rate concentrates, and where customer outcomes are worst. You will build a clear, prioritised list of issues for partner teams to work through.
You will represent the voice of the customer in the rooms where decisions get made about your markets. That means preparing and presenting data in product reviews, weekly/monthly business reviews and planning sessions, so the cost of poor customer experience is concrete and attributable, and so partner teams understand what is being asked of them and why.
You will build working relationships with partner teams in engineering, marketplace operations, courier operations, and finance, and you will track the fixes they commit to through to completion. You will feed results back into the program so everyone can see what worked, and to ensure defects are eliminated for good.
You will maintain and improve the data infrastructure and reporting that underpins this work, ensuring customer experience insights are credible, available and actionable.
Our humble expectations
The right person for this role has spent time inside a large-scale customer experience or operations function, and has direct experience translating customer defects through identification, root cause analysis and resolution. They are comfortable working with imperfect data, and they know how to build a credible case when the evidence is directional rather than conclusive.
Strong analytical instincts are essential. This person needs to know what questions to ask of the data and whether the answers make sense. Prior exposure to a successful voice of the customer (VoC) program is critical.
There is a meaningful cross-functional dimension to the role. This person will spend real time getting other teams to prioritise work that benefits the customer but may compete with other priorities. That requires good judgement, clear communication, and the ability to build trust quickly with people outside their reporting line.
The role also requires the ability to drive results in a dynamic and ambiguous landscape. The right person will combine introducing structure and rigor, while being agile and responsive to changing priorities and emerging issues.
This is a high impact and high visibility role, with the opportunity to interact with stakeholders and teams across the full customer lifecycle. The role will also span across 40 EMEA Roo & Wolt markets, meaning there is an opportunity to drive financial and customer experience results at scale.
Next steps
You will first meet with our Talent Acquisition team to understand role and company fit. Then, you will meet with the Hiring Manager who will talk through your relevant experience and ask you competency based questions that assess your suitability for the role.

The third stage is an assignment, where you will be given a business problem to think through, and present back to the team. If successful, there may be a final conversation with a more senior stakeholder. Throughout all stages, you will have plenty of opportunities to ask any questions about the role, team or company.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Allocated Bullion Exchange (ABX)
Allocated Bullion Exchange (ABX) is the world’s leading electronic institutional exchange for allocated physical precious metals. The ABX brings global trading, price discovery, and clearing facilities into one standardised and secure online trading environment via our groundbreaking exchange trading platform, MetalDesk.
The exchange introduces a new, centrally cleared, transparent, and cost-effective allocated exchange system and standard for the industry by offering precious metal market participants an exchange where they are able to trade, deliver, or store physical precious metal in 7 global locations.

ABX gives market participants across the world direct access to one integrated and consolidated global wholesale bullion market. We have enhanced market efficiency, introduced inclusiveness and accessibility, and provided relevant real-time price discovery.
ABX has modernised, globalised, & Integrated the precious metal markets by redefining the way physical bullion is traded. We connect all major global liquidity centres and break down the barriers to entry to the global wholesale market for all market participants.

Located at the Joint Force Headquarter State (JFHQ-State), the primary purpose of this position is to provide preventive, remedial, and support services aimed at improving and sustaining the psychological health of National Guard (NG) military members and their families.

As part of the Office of the State Surgeon the incumbent exercises technical oversight, plans, coordinates, monitors and provides access to a full range of professional services for the eligible populations served.

Duties focus on outreach, education and prevention, needs-based and psychosocial assessment, diagnosis, short-term problem resolution, and provision of or referral to evidenced-based interventions.

Serves as the National Guard community liaison with military and non-military agencies to promote and achieve timely information exchange, coordinate collaborative prevention efforts, and establish and maintain an extensive array of resources, associations, and community partnerships.

Participates in community activities to incorporate complex strategies that enhance community strengths, reduces broad-based community needs, implements community problem solving methods, and forges community connections to promote psychologically healthy lifestyles.

Job Description
Join Olsson’s Federal Engineering & Design Team as a Project Manager II, where you will support the delivery of impactful infrastructure projects for federal clients. In this role, you will work with multidisciplinary teams to plan, design, and support construction for mission-critical facilities for military bases, VA campuses, and other government agencies. These projects require technical excellence, regulatory accuracy, and strong collaboration.
As a Project Manager II, you will oversee project deliverables for small- to mid-sized projects within a single discipline or defined area, as well as low-risk multidisciplinary projects, or provide support on larger project teams. You will be involved throughout the full project life cycle, managing scope, schedule, budget, and quality to ensure projects are completed on time and within established parameters.
You will collaborate closely with internal teams and federal stakeholders to support compliance with UFC, DoD, VA, and other applicable federal standards. From early concept development through project delivery, you will help guide teams toward practical, high-quality engineering and design solutions that meet client needs.
In addition, you will contribute to proposal development and support continuous improvement efforts that enhance our federal design capabilities. This role offers the opportunity to support projects that serve national interests while building your project management expertise within a collaborative team environment.

A minimum of six years of project experience in the Architecture, Engineering, or Construction industry with increasing responsibility.
Proven success managing multidisciplinary teams and delivering federal projects for agencies such as DoD and VA.
Strong understanding of federal design standards, acquisition processes, contract requirements, and project financials.
Exceptional leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
High-level proficiency in client service, negotiation, and decision-making.
Ability to navigate complex regulatory environments with precision and integrity.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in fast-paced settings and exceed client expectations.
Strong interpersonal skills and a commitment to mentoring and team development.
Deep understanding of consulting business operations and a drive to contribute to firm-wide success.

Assemble and lead federal design teams, aligning technical expertise with project goals and applicable federal requirements.
Define and communicate project scope in coordination with technical teams and develop project schedules and budgets in collaboration with clients and contractors.
Develop and manage project budgets, review costs, and track financial performance to ensure adherence to planned budgets, client satisfaction, and overall project success.
Serve as the primary point of contact for clients and stakeholders, maintaining alignment on expectations, performance, and compliance with UFC, DoD, VA, and other applicable federal standards.
Identify potential risks, scope changes, and additional costs, and implement mitigation strategies to minimize financial and operational impacts.
Manage contracts, change orders, and support contract negotiations, including coordination with technical disciplines on billing and contract requirements.
Develop and implement quality management and quality assurance plans to ensure projects meet client expectations and firm standards.
Plan, organize, and lead routine project meetings with clients and project teams to support communication, alignment, and progress tracking.
Oversee the preparation, delivery, and maintenance of project documentation, including design plans, specifications, correspondence, and performance records.
Mentor and support team members by promoting project management best practices using Olsson Project Management programs and related resources.

Contribute to projects that serve national interests and make a difference in communities.
Enjoy flexible work arrangements, including remote options, to support your work-life balance.
Thrive in a supportive culture that values professional development and teamwork.
At Olsson, your expertise drives progress on projects that matter. If you’re passionate about federal civil engineering and ready to elevate your career, we want to hear from you.

Additional Information
Olsson specializes in engineering and design, client advisory services, planning, field services, and environmental. Improving the world has been our mindset from the very beginning, back when Olsson first opened for business in 1956. And it will be our mindset for years to come.

We are the Process and Tooling team supporting CIA Network Fiber, focused on simplifying how teams plan, source, deliver, and manage fiber work across regions. We focus on standardizing processes, improving tool adoption, clarifying ownership, and enabling better decision-making through reliable data and well-defined workflows.

The Agile Delivery Manager (ADM) is accountable for delivering business value across one or more agile teams, specifically in support of the organization’s digital transformation.

Acting as a servant leader and connector between strategic intent and operational execution, the ADM sits at the bridge point between the product/feature layer (Product Owners, Business Analysts, Business Owners) and the delivery layer (Engineering Managers, Developers, QA, and the Scrum Masters who own team-level performance).

The ADM ensures that delivery aligns with product roadmaps, value streams, and enterprise priorities.
This role is not about managing tasks—it’s about enabling flow, clarity, and measurable outcomes that advance the organization’s customer and business goals. The ADM owns the health and predictability of the Program Increment (PI): making sure it is planned well, tracked honestly, and delivered against — while escalating risks and dependencies before they become blockers. .

Integrate AI voice and text-based role-play tools into a manager "practice arena" to simulate high-complexity coaching, performance management, and alignment scenarios to assist managers with the development of their direct reports.
Optimize modern AI tools and LLM-based tech to build engaging, hyper-personalized manager support tools that empower leaders to be highly effective.
Tailored Enablement Delivery & Architecture
Develop specialized, distinct enablement pathways that address the priority KPIs of Customer Care (TTR/C (Time to Resolve/Close), CSAT (Customer Satisfaction), Transfer Rate, and AHT (Average Handle Time)) and CSM KPIs (Save Rate, Churn Mitigation, Downsell prevention).
Drive key manager KPIs in Coaching Compliance, Coaching Effectiveness, and Manager Engagement.
Design, build, and iterate on the onboarding design for new managers, including newly promoted, as well as the continuous development and enablement of tenured managers.
Ensure managers are deeply versed on organizational, product, and process changes, and fully equipped to translate those changes effectively to their teams during Huddles and dedicated coaching sessions to ensure adoption and effective application by their agents.
Influence, Analytics & Evaluation
Align and influence cross-functional Senior Leader and Director-level stakeholders as a trusted thought partner, managing massive programmatic changes across distributed teams.
Proactively identify global areas of opportunity to support managers and leadership, providing ready solutions backed by a high rigor of analytical and performance assessment.
Lead as a Center of Excellence globally, evaluating behavioral opportunity areas and structuring remedial manager initiatives both internally as well as shared with BPO partners.
Establish robust post-enablement measurement frameworks to evaluate learning impact, leveraging AI analytics to track real-world performance improvements and core business KPIs.

5-8 years of experience delivering high-impact enablement, training infrastructure, leadership development curriculum, or performance coaching strategies within a fast-paced SaaS, Fintech, or fast-growth tech environment.
Demonstrated ability as a senior leader to align cross-functional VP and Director-level stakeholders, manage massive programmatic changes, and drive process discipline across fragmented teams.
Proven domain expertise navigating both transactional/queue-based operational environments (Customer Care/Support) and relationship-driven commercial environments (Customer Success/Account Management).
A strong portfolio of work demonstrating the ability to take an ambiguous, loosely defined objective and turn it into a scalable, repeatable corporate program.
Bachelor’s degree required, with an advanced degree in Adult Learning, Organizational Development, or a related discipline highly preferred.
Power-user familiarity with modern customer stacks, learning tools, and data analytics dashboards (e.g., Salesforce, CRMs, LMS tools, and AI platform assistants).

Ability to leverage AI technology to deliver and measure proven learning impact, moving beyond traditional completion rates to extract deep leader performance insights.
Proven ability to leverage AI to analyze complex leadership learning opportunities, recommend and gain buy-in on the right solution for complicated business needs, and follow through to completion.
Prior experience managing managers and coaching coaches, as a force multiplier across a multi-team organization.
Prior experience working within the restaurant and/or tech space, or a deep personal understanding of restaurant operations and hospitality.
Self-motivated disposition with a relentless "fixer" mindset—the ability to see the big picture and solve root-cause problems rather than immediate symptoms.
Project management certifications (such as PMP or PMO framework familiarity) or a proven track record of applying formal project management methodologies to scale complex enablement lifecycles.

A major function of the Office of Data Acquisitions is to provide databases developed from state highway safety related data for use in analyses aimed at reducing deaths, injuries, crashes, and medical costs.

As the Director, the incumbent will be responsible for the following: Advising the Associate Administrator on all matters related to the design, development, coordination, and management of crash investigation and data collection, and their contribution to achieving the mission of NHTSA.

Keeps the Associate Administrator fully informed as to the status of programs and of problems and controversial issues.

Collaborates closely with the Associate Administrator and other top officials of NHTSA to identify the agency's crash research and data needs, to determine techniques and methods by which the office can meet those needs, to estimate the cost and time required to meet the needs, and to determine other implications of changes.

Carrying out personnel management responsibilities for a staff of professional, technical, administrative and clerical support personnel. Makes decisions on work problems presented by subordinate supervisors and key specialists.

Evaluates performance of subordinate supervisors and reviews evaluations made by supervisors of subordinate employee's performance. Establishing policy and provides management oversight of the State Data Reporting Systems Division responsible for the crash record-based data.

Crash record based data includes the Fatality Analysis Reporting System (FARS), a fundamental national data base on traffic safety, Crash Report Sampling System (CRSS), Not-in-Traffic System (NTS) and the State Electronic Data Collection Program (SEDC)., The Division also provides the expertise in sample design and quality control to the other offices in the National Center for Statistics and Analysis, the rest of NHTSA and other offices in DOT.

Establishing policy and provides management oversight of the Crash Investigation Division (CID), provides executive leadership in the planning, design, development, coordination, and management of national networks of motor vehicle traffic crash research and data collection activities.

These include the operation of a national system to conduct detailed investigations of a well-defined selection of motor vehicle crashes currently the Crash Investigation Sampling System (CISS)); and the Special Crash Investigations (SCI) program of special investigations of crashes of particular, interest; and Systems for collecting, supplementing, and coding data from police crash reports to provide special purpose data files.

Maintaining liaison with other Federal agencies, State and local governments, police agencies, hospitals, private safety groups, motor vehicle and equipment manufacturers, crash research and analysis organizations, professional societies, and other groups with an interest in crash investigation and crash data for the purposes are for exchanging crash data and information on crash research technology, encouraging the use of crash data, and cooperating on crash research programs.

The ideal candidate is a data executive and systems expert with a track record of managing federal data collection, automation, and national crash investigation programs.

They possess the strategic and technical skills to lead multi-disciplinary teams while directing the human resource, budgetary, and procurement parameters vital to national highway safety initiatives.

A skilled collaborator, they excel at building partnerships across federal, state, and private sectors including law enforcement, public health, and the automotive industry to secure cooperation and advance data systems.

Furthermore, they bring expertise in data governance, enforcing quality control and data completeness while protecting individual privacy, ensuring the delivery of accurate databases that support national safety research and rulemaking.
To meet the minimum qualifications for this position, you must meet the specialized experience qualifications.

To qualify for the Grade 15, you must have at least one year of specialized experience equal or equivalent to the GS-14, it must include: Experience directing multi-disciplinary professional, technical, and administrative teams while managing the organizational, human resource, and budgetary parameters vital to national highway traffic safety initiatives.

Experience communicating with system managers, rulemaking engineers, researchers, technicians, traffic safety administrators, Governor's Representatives for Highway Safety, State and local officials, national data system program managers and others associated with the application of data as it applies to helping solve complex safety issues.

Experience establishing policy and overseeing large federal data divisions to ensure data completeness, security, and rigorous quality control. Examples include working with executive leadership to plan, develop, and manage large-scale national data collection systems and multi-level crash investigation programs.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES (KSAs): Your qualifications will be evaluated on the basis of your level of knowledge, skills, abilities and/or competencies in the following areas: Technical Knowledge: Knowledge of federal budgeting to manage large divisional funds, appropriations, large-scale national data architecture, data collection methodologies, complex procurement or contracting mechanisms and systems engineering principles required to build and sustain nationwide databases.

Leadership and Supervision: Management and/or team leader skills, including the ability to direct, manage, and develop a diverse, high-performing human resources workforce of technical and administrative staff.

Communication: Communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, including the ability to secure community support, build strategic intergovernmental alliances, and establish private-sector data-sharing partnerships.

Reasoning: Ability to collaborate across federal, state, and private boundaries to improve data accessibility while balancing competing stakeholder priorities.

For all types of consideration, experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

The Educational Program Manager provides leadership and supervision to staff; develops professional development programs for educators; develops, manages and evaluates onsite, distance and online learning initiatives and student programming; and collaborates with internal and external partners to advance the CVC's educational mission.

Duties As an Educational Program Manager, you will: Provide administrative and technical supervision to subordinate staff, including assigning work, evaluating performance, establishing performance expectations, approving leave, providing coaching and training, and addressing employee performance and conduct matters.

Lead and motivate staff and multidisciplinary teams responsible for developing and delivering educational and public programming. Plan, develop, implement and evaluate professional development programs for educators, including teacher workshops, advisory groups and other educational initiatives.

Research and develop educational content, activities, primary source materials and resources that support program goals and applicable educational standards. Develop, manage and implement distance learning programs and digital educational resources for local and national audiences.

Research emerging practices and technologies related to virtual learning and educational programming and collaborate with information technology and audiovisual professionals to implement distance learning products.

Develop and manage onsite educational programs for students and other audiences, including establishing program goals, learning objectives, interpretive methods and quality-assurance standards.

Lead and participate in cross functional teams responsible for developing and improving student tours, educational programs and the overall school-group experience. Evaluate educational programs and recommend improvements based on program objectives, audience needs and recognized practices within informal learning environments.

Coordinate with staff, volunteers, educators, schools and other stakeholders to schedule and deliver educational and public programs. Collaborate with Communications and Marketing staff to promote educational programs and develop content for websites, handouts, brochures, signs and other educational and outreach materials.

Establish and maintain relationships with educators, schools, community organizations and other stakeholders to promote the Capitol Visitor Center as a resource for civic education.

As Growth Products GTM & Program Manager for APAC, you will be the dedicated go-to-market architect and program execution lead for ServiceNow's highest-priority growth products across the region.

Specifically, you will own the GTM strategy and regional program management for Security and Identity solutions (Armis, Veza), AI-powered employee productivity (Moveworks), and the AI control tower (AICT) suite - driving pipeline, sales activation, and customer adoption across India, Asia & Korea, and ANZ.
This is a highly cross-functional role at the intersection of strategy and field execution. You will translate global product GTM strategies into APAC-ready programs that field teams can land and scale.

Working alongside regional Business Managers, field sales, marketing, and channel teams, you will design and run the plays, cadences, and programs that move these products from emerging to established motions in the region.

A core part of your mandate is driving AI acceleration - ensuring the field is equipped, activated, and executing on AI-native opportunities across all growth products.
This role requires someone who thrives at the pace of a product launch - able to hold multiple GTM programs simultaneously, build trust with both product specialist teams and field sales, and turn strategy into measurable pipeline and revenue outcomes. You will have direct visibility into ServiceNow's most strategically important growth bets and the opportunity to shape how APAC leads the way in making them successful.

Own the end-to-end GTM program for Armis, Veza, Moveworks, and AICT across APAC. Design and execute regional landing plans for each product, working with global product teams to translate strategy into APAC-contextualized plays, coverage models, and pipeline programs.
Drive sales activation and field readiness across APAC markets for the growth products. Build and deliver enablement programs, landing kits, and competitive positioning that equip field teams to identify, qualify, and close growth product opportunities.
Lead AI native sales acceleration across the APAC field. Define the APAC approach to AI-native selling, track adoption across regions, identify blockers, and work with the Head of APAC GTM and regional Business Managers to drive consistent execution against AI-native pipeline targets.
Build and manage program cadences across all growth products — tracking deal momentum, stakeholder alignment, and cross-functional execution. Maintain a clear view of pipeline health, top opportunities, and program risks across the portfolio.
Partner with Marketing to co-design and execute demand generation programs, events, and pipeline acceleration campaigns specific to growth products. Ensure marketing investment is aligned to the moments and accounts that matter most for each product.
Coordinate with partner teams to integrate the channel into growth product GTM motions. Define the partner play for each product, identify top partners by Major Area, and ensure partner-sourced pipeline is tracked and accelerating.
Represent the growth products portfolio in APAC pipeline reviews, QBRs, and leadership forums. Provide structured updates on program performance, pipeline coverage, and execution gaps — with clear recommendations for intervention.
Serve as the APAC voice to global product and GTM teams for Armis, Veza, Moveworks, and AICT. Surface APAC-specific market intelligence, competitive dynamics, and execution feedback that informs global strategy and product roadmap decisions.

Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
~10 years of total work experience, with 5+ years in GTM strategy, sales strategy, product GTM, or program management in enterprise software or SaaS.
Demonstrated experience running go-to-market programs for emerging or recently launched enterprise products - including sales enablement, pipeline generation, field activation, and adoption tracking.
Strong understanding of enterprise software sales motions, including specialist sales, channel/partner dynamics, and the interplay between field sales and product GTM teams. Experience with security, identity, or AI product categories is a plus.
Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent programs at pace - comfortable holding four product motions simultaneously, prioritizing across competing demands, and delivering through influence rather than authority.
Cross-functional collaborator who builds trust quickly with both field-facing and product-facing stakeholders.
Strong analytical capabilities - able to build pipeline models, track program performance, identify gaps, and present clear, data-backed recommendations to senior leadership.
APAC experience and regional awareness strongly preferred. Understands the market dynamics, customer buying patterns, and cultural nuances across India, Asia & Korea, and ANZ, and knows how to adapt global GTM plays accordingly.
Exceptional communicator - clear, concise, and confident in both executive forums and working sessions. Able to prepare and deliver crisp updates to senior stakeholders and facilitate cross-functional alignment with ease.
Self-starter who thrives in ambiguous, high-growth environments. Energized by building structure where none exists, moving fast, and learning new product domains quickly.

The Infrastructure Service Delivery Manager is responsible for overseeing the delivery, operation, and continuous improvement of infrastructure services across both Cloud and On-Premises environments. This role ensures that infrastructure services meet business requirements, service level commitments, security standards, and operational excellence .

The individual will act as the key interface between technical teams, business stakeholders, customers, and external service providers to ensure reliable, scalable, and cost-effective infrastructure services.

Lead the end-to-end delivery and management of infrastructure services across Cloud and On-Premises environments, including servers, storage, virtualization, networks, databases, and platform services.
Manage infrastructure operations teams and service providers, ensuring high availability, performance, and timely resolution of incidents, problems, and service requests in accordance with agreed SLAs and KPIs.
Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders and customers regarding infrastructure service performance, escalations, and operational governance.
Collaborate with business units, application teams, cybersecurity teams, and technology partners to align infrastructure services with organizational objectives and transformation initiatives.
Drive continuous service improvement initiatives focused on reliability, automation, optimization, operational efficiency, and user experience.
Oversee infrastructure lifecycle management, including capacity planning, patching, upgrades, refresh programs, and technology modernization initiatives.
Ensure effective management of Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and On-Premises data center environments, maintaining operational consistency and governance standards.
Monitor infrastructure health, service performance, utilization, and availability metrics; prepare operational reports and present insights to senior leadership.
Ensure compliance with ITIL best practices, security policies, regulatory requirements, and organizational governance frameworks.
Lead incident, problem, change, and release management processes to minimize service disruptions and ensure business continuity.
Coordinate disaster recovery planning, business continuity testing, and resilience initiatives across infrastructure environments.
Manage vendor relationships, contracts, and third-party service providers to ensure service quality, cost optimization, and contractual compliance.
Facilitate knowledge sharing, operational readiness, and team development to enhance technical capabilities and service maturity.

Bachelor’s degree/Master’s degree(BE/ME) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
Experience : 10+ Years

Proven experience (8+ years) in hybrid infrastructure environment including Cloud and On-premises platforms
Strong knowledge of ITIL processes and Service Management principles.
Experience managing infrastructure services such as compute, Storage, Virtualization, networking and monitoring
Knowledge of Cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform.
Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to handle multiple priorities and complex projects.
Relevant certifications such as ITIL, AWS, Azure, GCP, PMP, or Prince2 are preferred.

Nescens est une institution suisse de référence dans les domaines de la médecine préventive et de la longévité.
